d: South Korea—a nation renowned for its technological advancements, ranked among the countries with the fastest internet speeds, where ‘K-Pop’ and ‘K-Dramas’ enjoy global fame, which is hailed as the capital of plastic surgery, and where one can experience the thrill of climbing the walls of Hwaseong Fortress—that is South Korea. There is so much to discover about this country that you simply must know. So, come join us on a journey to South Korea—on Infinity Stream.
